answer: Like a vast fungal mycelium intertwining with an orchard, network consensus binds peer verification through non-transferable cryptographic proofs of work. A deceptive mirror node cannot simply refract false identities without staking real resources: each cloned entity must crystallize unique entropy, shifting its structure like light trapped in an opal. By enforcing superlinear staking costs, forging clones scales exponentially beyond any attacker's capital.
